scope: source-first intake of eight fruit-tree species; Apricot/Cherry (CG-59), Orange/Peach (CG-60), Apple/Pomegranate (CG-61) selected for Home/Field V0; Banana/Mango remain draft

source_facts.fact: Eight fruit trees produce their matching fruit when mature and in season: Apricot/Cherry in Spring, Banana/Mango/Orange/Peach in Summer, and Apple/Pomegranate in Fall. The source game produces one fruit per day and can hold up to three before harvest; these numbers are not paper cadence.
Axe chopping a fruit tree yields normal Wood and a matching sapling; an immature stage-1 tree yields only its sapling. The source page does not specify a Little Valley Cards stump rule.

Fruit trees grow from saplings planted on untilled ground. Banana and Mango saplings have island-linked acquisition in the source; mature trees on Ginger Island or in the Greenhouse bear fruit year-round. Lightning can temporarily replace fruit production with Coal.

source_facts.source: Stardew Valley Wiki — Orange Sapling / Peach Sapling
source_facts.fact: Orange and Peach saplings are conventional shop-sourced fruit trees in the source game; both produce matching fruit in Summer. See https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Peach_Sapling for Peach.

source_facts.source: Stardew Valley Wiki — Apple Sapling / Pomegranate Sapling
source_facts.fact: Apple and Pomegranate saplings have shop sources in the source game and produce matching fruit in Fall. See https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Pomegranate_Sapling for Pomegranate.
